notes: Move the window by dragging from anywhere, not just the header
Resize from any edge or corner (size and position are remembered)
Name your clips and search by name or text

Move from anywhere: Drag from any empty spot, including the list background, tabs and footer, or press-and-drag an item. A plain click still pastes, and it only counts as a drag after the mouse moves about 6 pixels.

Resize: Drag any edge or corner, and the cursor changes to show it. The minimum size is 300 × 260. Item text re-wraps as the window gets wider or narrower. The window's size, position and theme are saved and restored on the next launch.

Name your clips: Click the pencil ✎ on an item, type a name such as "Work email", then press Enter (Esc cancels). The name shows above the text, and search matches text or names. Names stay when you copy the same text again.
Day/night mode: Click the ☀ / ☾ button in the header. It switches the whole window and is remembered.
Click-to-paste clipboard history docked above the taskbar
Search, pin favourites, hover tooltips and update check
